option.nebulon.held_item.no_equip.desc: Removes the equip animation: when you switch items, the new item is in your hand at once instead of being lowered and raised.
module.nebulon.hud_tweaks.description: Makes screen effects less annoying: smaller fire, no damage tilt, no nausea.
option.nebulon.hud_tweaks.low_fire.desc: The burning effect on screen sits lower, so it covers much less of your view.
option.nebulon.hud_tweaks.no_damage_tilt: The camera no longer tilts when you take damage.
option.nebulon.hud_tweaks.no_nausea.desc: Removes the wobbling and distortion of the nausea effect.
module.nebulon.held_item.description: Adjust the item in your hand in first person: position, size, swing speed and hit animation.
option.nebulon.held_item.x.desc: Moves the item sideways (outwards / towards the middle).
option.nebulon.held_item.y.desc: Moves the item up or down.
option.nebulon.held_item.z.desc: Moves the item away from you or closer.
option.nebulon.held_item.scale.desc: Size of the item in your hand.
option.nebulon.held_item.swing_speed.des: Speed of the hit animation (200 % = twice as fast). Only the animation changes, not your attacks.
option.nebulon.held_item.ignore_haste.de: Haste and Mining Fatigue no longer make the hit animation faster or slower; only Swing Speed counts.
option.nebulon.held_item.swing_style.des: Normal: vanilla swing. Tilt: no swing, the item just tips forward briefly. None: no hit animation.
option.nebulon.held_item.reset.desc: Sets position, size, speed and style back to normal.
module.nebulon.anti_mouse_reset.descript: The mouse is not forced back into the middle when you switch between inventories, chests and menus
module.nebulon.command_keybinds.descript: Keys that run SkyBlock commands: /loadouts, /pets and /stats. Each command has its own key.
option.nebulon.command_keybinds.loadouts: Runs /loadouts. Click, then press a key or mouse button; Escape removes the binding.
option.nebulon.command_keybinds.pets.des: Runs /pets. Click, then press a key or mouse button; Escape removes the binding.
option.nebulon.command_keybinds.stats.de: Runs /stats. Click, then press a key or mouse button; Escape removes the binding.
screen.nebulon.title: Nebulon
option.nebulon.edit_gui.desc: Opens the Gui Editor to move and resize the Inventory Display.
screen.nebulon.inventory_qol.tab.invento: Various settings to improve the look of the Inventory
Display your Inventory as a GUI
screen.nebulon.inventory_qol.tab.slot_bi: Lets you connect inventory and hotbar slots together
option.nebulon.inventory_display.enabled: Shows the Inventory Display on the HUD (while Inventory QOL is on).
option.nebulon.slot_binding.enabled.desc: Turns Slot Binding on (while Inventory QOL is on).
option.nebulon.use_mod_font.desc: Draws this element in the mod's font (Roboto). Off: Minecraft's font, or the font of your texture pack.
category.nebulon.hint: Drag to move. Right-click to collapse or expand the category.
module.nebulon.darkmode_mist.description: Adds a Dark Variant to the Mist
module.nebulon.fullbright.description: Makes everything fully bright, even in the dark
module.nebulon.inventory_display.descrip: Shows your inventory on the screen. Move and resize it in the Gui Editor (Settings).
Also shows the hotbar row under the inventory.
module.nebulon.inferno_demonlord.descrip: Helpers for the Blaze slayer boss: hide the fire, attunement colours and fire pillar alerts.
option.nebulon.inferno.hide_fire.desc: While the boss is spawned, all fire particles and fireballs are invisible, to make killing the boss much more enjoyable.
option.nebulon.inferno.hide_potion.desc: While the boss is spawned, potion and effect swirl particles are invisible.
option.nebulon.inferno.attunement.desc: The boss (and its demons) glow in the colour of their current attunement: Ashen (dark gray), Spirit (white), Auric (yellow), Crystal (aqua).
option.nebulon.inferno.pillar_alert.desc: Shows a title on screen when a fire pillar has spawned, with its timer and hits.
screen.nebulon.enchant_parsing.tab.qol.d: Shows which enchants are still missing on an item
screen.nebulon.enchant_parsing.tab.max.d: Style of enchants at their maximum level
screen.nebulon.enchant_parsing.tab.near_: Style of enchants one level below their maximum
screen.nebulon.enchant_parsing.tab.norma: Style of enchants two or more levels below their maximum
module.nebulon.enchant_display.descripti: Shows which enchants are still missing on an item (not which can be upgraded), in gray under its enchants. No ultimate enchants and no enchants that conflict with applied ones.
option.nebulon.enchant_display.missing.d: Lists the enchants the item type can get but does not have yet (Hypixel SkyBlock enchants, without ultimates and conflicting ones).
option.nebulon.enchant_display.color.des: Colours the applied enchants by level: max level, one level below max and lower levels. Ultimate enchants keep their colour.
option.nebulon.enchant_display.max_color: Colour of enchants at their maximum level (chroma possible).
option.nebulon.enchant_display.near_max_: Colour of enchants one level below their maximum.
option.nebulon.enchant_display.normal_co: Colour of enchants two or more levels below their maximum.
Max Level enchants are written bold.
option.nebulon.enchant_display.max_itali: Max Level enchants are written italic.
option.nebulon.enchant_display.max_strik: Max Level enchants are written struck through.
option.nebulon.enchant_display.near_max_: Max - 1 enchants are written struck through.
option.nebulon.enchant_display.normal_bo: Normal Level enchants are written bold.
option.nebulon.enchant_display.normal_it: Normal Level enchants are written italic.
option.nebulon.enchant_display.normal_st: Normal Level enchants are written struck through.
module.nebulon.scrollable_tooltips.descr: Item tooltips that are too big for the screen can be scrolled with the mouse wheel (Shift + wheel: sideways)
module.nebulon.rarity.description: Shows the Rarity of Items as a coloured Circle behind them
option.nebulon.rarity_shape.desc: Circle behind the item, or the whole slot in the rarity colour.
option.nebulon.opacity.desc: Opacity of the rarity background, from 5 % (barely visible) to 100 % (fully opaque).
option.nebulon.targets.desc: Which mobs are marked: Hostile (monsters), All Mobs, or only the Custom List. Click to switch.
option.nebulon.custom_list.desc: Entity ids for the Custom List, separated by commas, e.g. minecraft:zombie, husk.
module.nebulon.performance_display.descr: Displays Fps, Tps, Ping and other useful Information
module.nebulon.menu_customisation.descri: Changes the general colour of this menu. Style and opacity stay the same.
option.nebulon.menu_color.desc: General colour of the menu. White is the original look. Brightness and opacity of every part stay the same; the labels of the Performance Display use this colour.
option.nebulon.show_tps.desc: Server ticks per second (20 = no lag), measured from the server's time updates.
option.nebulon.show_ping.desc: Your latency to the server in milliseconds, as shown in the tab list.
option.nebulon.reset_menu_color.desc: Sets the menu colour back to the default (white = original look).
option.nebulon.background_opacity.desc: Opacity of the box background, from 0 % (invisible, only text) to 100 % (fully opaque).
option.nebulon.reset_display.desc: Size back to 100 % and position back to the default. To resize, hold the box in this menu with the left mouse button and scroll.
option.nebulon.display_layout.desc: Horizontal: all values in one line. Vertical: one value per line. Click to switch.
option.nebulon.text_depth.desc: Gives the text a little depth without standing out. Shadow: soft shadow. Extrude: thin 3D edge in a darker shade. Glow: faint halo in the menu colour. Click to switch.
module.nebulon.gui_editor.description: Left-click to open the GUI editor and move your displays.
screen.nebulon.gui_editor.hint: Drag a display to move it  ·  Hold it and scroll to resize  ·  Esc to go back
module.nebulon.visual_tweaks.description: Inventory improvements. Right-click opens a window with the tabs Inventory, Inventory Display and Slot Binding.
option.nebulon.remove_recipe_book.desc: Removes the recipe book and its button from the inventory, crafting table and furnaces for a cleaner look.
option.nebulon.remove_offhand.desc: Removes the offhand slot from the inventory, so it can no longer be clicked.
option.nebulon.hide_inventory_effects.de: Hides the list of active potion effects next to the inventory.
option.nebulon.mod_style.desc: Shows all inventories, containers and menus in the flat look of the mod (the mod's base colours). Only the inventory background is see-through (10 %).
module.nebulon.particles.description: Hides particles and effects you don't want to see.
option.nebulon.hide_block_breaking.desc: Hides the particles that come when a block is broken (and while it is being mined).
option.nebulon.hide_lightning.desc: Hides all lightning bolts and their sky flash, e.g. from the Thunderlord / Thunderbolt enchantments.
option.nebulon.hide_explosions.desc: Hides all explosion particles, e.g. from creepers or TNT.
option.nebulon.hide_entity_fire.desc: Burning mobs and players are drawn without the fire on them.
option.nebulon.hide_smoke.desc: Hides all kinds of smoke particles (smoke, large smoke, campfire smoke, mob death clouds).
module.nebulon.item_tweaks.description: Small Tweaks to how Items are shown
option.nebulon.item_tweaks.compact_stars: Shows master stars as red stars instead of the extra number: each master star turns one of the five gold stars red.
option.nebulon.item_tweaks.ultimate_ench: Shows the ultimate enchant of an item in the top right of its slot: Combo CO, Soul Eater SE, Chimera CH, Duplex DU, Fatal Tempo FT, Inferno IF, One For All OFA, Rend RE, Swarm SW, Ultimate Jerry UJ, Ultimate Wise UW.
option.nebulon.item_tweaks.ultimate_inve: Shows the ultimate enchants only while an inventory or menu is open, not on the hotbar.
module.nebulon.auction_input.description: Replaces the auction price sign with a proper text box (10m, 5.5k ...) and an undercut mode. Enter clicks Create / Confirm in the auction menus.
option.nebulon.auction_input.default_mod: The input mode used when the price box opens. Undercut enters the lowest BIN minus the typed amount.
option.nebulon.auction_input.remember_te: Restores the last typed price when the price box opens again.
option.nebulon.auction_input.remember_mo: Restores the last used mode instead of the default mode.
module.nebulon.item_prices.description: Shows prices from Coflnet in item tooltips: the lowest BIN, or the bazaar Insta-Buy and Insta-Sell price for bazaar items.
option.nebulon.item_prices.lowest_bin.de: The cheapest Buy It Now auction of auction house items (pets per rarity).
option.nebulon.item_prices.bazaar.desc: The Insta-Buy and Insta-Sell price of items sold on the bazaar.
option.nebulon.item_prices.stack_total.d: For stacks of more than one item, also shows the price of the whole stack.
screen.nebulon.auction_input.title: Set Auction Price
module.nebulon.slot_binding.description: Allows you to bind slots to hotbar slots for quick item swaps.
key.nebulon.slot_binding: Slot Binding (link slots in the inventory)
option.nebulon.slot_binding.key.desc: Press while hovering a hotbar slot and an inventory slot to link them. Press over a bound slot to remove its binding. Shift + left click swaps bound slots.
option.nebulon.slot_binding.hover_only.d: Only shows bound slots when hovering over them.
Draws a border around bound slots.
option.nebulon.slot_binding.draw_line.de: Draws a line between bound slots.
option.nebulon.slot_binding.border_color: Colour of the borders and of the lines between bound slots.
module.nebulon.protect_item.description: Prevents dropping or selling important items via /protectitem or keybind (L in a menu).
key.nebulon.protect_item: Protect Item (hovered item in a menu)
option.nebulon.protect.key.desc: Press while hovering an item in an inventory to protect/unprotect it via UUID. Click, then press a key or mouse button; Escape removes the binding.
option.nebulon.protect.notification.desc: Shows a notification on the bottom right side of the screen when the feature saved your item.
option.nebulon.protect.show_protected.de: Shows protected items in container GUIs with a small indicator.
option.nebulon.protect.uuid.desc: Protects the items you protected with the key or /protectitem (this exact item).
